design: Fixed-size matched-seed simulation study. No interim estimates, early stopping, or changes to candidates.
decoder: single_cz_diagnostics.diagnose, physical weight-at-most-two table then fixed GF2 fallback, decoded fidelity within 1e-10 of 1
secondary_metrics: mean raw and decoded fidelity conditional on acceptance
cost_denominator: All observed work on all attempts, including failed, discarded, retried and unresolved work, divided by the number of decoded accepted matches. Unresolved attempts contribute zero matches.
uncertainty: 95% Wilson acceptance and match intervals per arm. Nominal 95% percentile paired bootstrap intervals for paired differences and ratios, resampling shared-seed groups (10000 resamples, seed 27711). Descriptive intervals per comparison without multiplicity adjustment.

noninferiority.meaning: At most 5% extra consumption of the named gate resource or at most two fewer useful outputs per 100 attempts, assessed separately. No omnibus throughput or equivalence claim.
